data.narrative:
Baykar is a privately held Defense & Security company founded by Özdemir Bayraktar. The valuation universe comprises 10 comparable firms: 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private competitors including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems. Within the 21-firm Defense & Security sector peer set, however, no sufficient cluster of same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables exists to support a reliable peer-median valuation.

The Peer-Median triangulation method is not applicable to Baykar. The analysis identified zero same-stage peers, zero adjacent-stage peers, and zero similar-valuation-tier peers meeting minimum thresholds. A cross-sector median calculation would introduce material distortion given Baykar's position within a niche, capital-intensive defense subsector where development timelines, revenue models, and risk profiles diverge substantially from broader Defense & Security operators. Relying on such a median would lack analytical rigor.

This analysis cannot support a quantified valuation range without additional methodologies—such as discounted cash flow analysis (if forward guidance exists), precedent transactions, or meaningful financial metrics from the target or peer set. The current dataset permits only structural framing: Baykar's valuation must be triangulated against the identified private peer set (Anduril, Helsing, Shield AI, et al.) using deal terms, funding multiples, or revenue multiples if those data become available. Public comparables alone are insufficient given stage and business-model heterogeneity.
